exposure: time delay between FBGA and delivery
cohort: 343 singleton term deliveries with nonreassuring fetal heart rate tracings (NRFHRT) according to Fédération Internationale de Gynécologie et d'Obstétrique and Fisher cardiotocography scores undergoing FBGA in a university hospital
finding: FBGA accurately predicted postpartum cord blood pH values with a margin of ±0.2 in 93% of cases but had a low positive predictive value for neonatal depression according to Apgar scores.
